name: perspective-tilt-text
title: Perspective Tilt Text
description: Display text on a plane that tilts toward the pointer with rotateX/rotateY, layered with a translateZ shadow copy so the depth reads as physical; the transform origin eases back to centre on leave.
designRules:
# Design System

Genre: Brutalist
Macrostructure: Asymmetric
Density: Airy
Shape: Sharp
Motion: Expressive
Typography: Variable Poster
Color: Duotone

## Rules

- Pointer Tilt: the interaction model is part of the design, not an add-on.
- Reduced motion replaces animation with a state change; nothing is hidden behind motion.
- The component composes through `cn` and never hardcodes colours.

## Avoid

- Reskinning this resource and republishing it under a new name.
- Adding shadows or radii that contradict its shape language.
